title: restore/undo representability, focus recovery, responsive acceptance
baseline_note: Coverage universe is bounded to the FOUR named #372 blockers only; it is not a full operator-journey matrix (#372 owns that). Reduction: equivalence classes per correction + named 3-way tuples (surface × action × outcome), (viewport × direction × theme). Excluded combinations are the non-#373 lifecycle actions already covered by scripts-lifecycle-367 / topic-item-governance packs.
acceptance_rule: every mandatory row passed; all other categories zero; serial, one worker, zero retries.

rows.prerequisite: a topic_review slot at TOPIC_PROPOSED (from the governed fixture)
rows.action: click Drop -> reload -> click Reopen -> reload
rows.expected_typed_result: drop {decision_recorded:true}; reopen 200 -> slot back to review status
rows.expected_ui: Reopen control visible+enabled only when dropped+decision; label maps 1:1 to reopen
rows.expected_persistence: audit_log 'reopened' row; slot status returns to review; independent read after reload
rows.reload_expectation: post-reopen the item reads in-review again on a fresh browser /gw read

rows.prerequisite: an in-review topic slot (no committed decision)

rows.action: click Drop -> reload -> click Reopen -> reload
rows.expected_ui: control labelled 'Reopen' (NOT 'Restore'); testid scripts-action-reopen; the prior Restore->reopen alias is gone

rows.prerequisite: a topic slot with a recorded (uncommitted) request_change decision on the single open gate
rows.action: click Send back -> reload -> click Undo decision -> reload
rows.expected_ui: Undo control enabled only when authoritative_gate_id present + decision exists; consumes projected gate id directly
rows.expected_persistence: gate_decision row removed; audit_log 'decision_cleared'; independent read after reload
rows.reload_expectation: send-back tally decremented / undecide unavailable(no_decision) after clear

rows.prerequisite: an in-review topic slot with no recorded decision
rows.expected_ui: Undo visible-but-disabled data-reason=no_decision; never fabricates a gate id

rows.prerequisite: any governed action whose control unmounts on success
rows.action: activate a control by keyboard; on settle assert focus moved to the announced role=status region
rows.expected_ui: focus lands on a tabIndex=-1 role=status aria-live region (no trap; predictable recovery); visible focus

rows.surface: WorkbenchShell + stage/lens rails + item panels + action controls
rows.action: at 375/768/1280 x {ltr,rtl} x {light,dark}: assert controls visible+reachable+ordered, no page-level horizontal overflow (internal scrollers excepted)
rows.expected_ui: no clipped/obscured/overlapping/unreachable control; 375 narrow contract preserved; FullCalendar untouched
rows.note: acceptance coverage only — NO CSS added (no reproduced candidate-head defect). A failure here would be a reproduced defect authorizing a minimal fix.

red_proofs: missing-reopen-control: with the reopen action removed from the panel, R1 loops fail (no rendered control).
inferred-gate-selection: with >1 open gate, authoritative_gate_id must be null and Undo unavailable(ambiguous_gate) — proven in gates.topic_recovery_selftest B3.
missing-focus-restoration: without the statusRef move, focus falls to <body> after a control unmounts.
absent-responsive-rule: a reproduced 768/1280 overflow/clip would fail R4 (none reproduced at this head).
